purpose: Source-backed technical facts for all 42 current element endpoint types and fifteen current relationship identifiers. Raw-table review, settled type decisions and whole-model conformance are separate.

source.publication: The Open Group C260, ArchiMate 4 Specification, April 2026
source.verification_method: Two independent visual transcriptions of the initial 1444 cells matched exactly. Two independent visual transcriptions of the remaining 320 cells were reconciled against fresh source crops; Product to BusinessInterface is Ofrtv. All 1764 cells retain exact letters, case, order, pages and original row/column indices. Separate semantic review retains eight narrow source-scope UNKNOWNs.

source.boundary: Technical implementation facts for the complete current-catalogue B.5 element-to-element matrix, with explicit scoped semantic qualifications. No PDF prose, images, document or standard artwork reproduced; no licence conclusion or new agreement. This does not implement the complete specification.

comparison_gate.comparison: Previous 1444 cells are unchanged. All 320 added cells match after independent fresh-source resolution of one initial mismatch, with exact case/order and original locators. Raw transcription and eight semantic qualifications are separate.

resolution.method: Both readers rechecked original PDF crops; lowercase r is present.

coordinate_policy: All page, source-column and target-row indices are one-based. Columns are counted within the printed page table, rows within its element rows.

scope.query_meaning: Explicit stored model edge, not uppercase/direct metamodel classification.
scope.permission_class_meaning: Uppercase matches are direct, lowercase matches are derived. A permitted derived-class stored edge requires no witnessed derivation chain.
scope.negative_policy: FORBIDDEN applies only when a family letter is absent from one of these 1764 individually checked cells and no explicit source-scope qualification applies. Unreviewed or unsupported queries never inherit a prohibition.
scope.endpoint_policy: All four Access identifiers use the same stored source/target direction. Read arrowheads do not transpose endpoints or the lookup pair.
scope.association_policy: All 1764 selected cells explicitly contain uppercase O. Both Association identifiers use that family; no omission-based Association negative is inferred.
scope.composition_policy: G/g maps to Aggregation and Composition only for these checked element endpoints. No permission for relationship or junction endpoints is inferred.
scope.type_pair_policy: A type-diagonal entry does not establish instance-level self-link, cycle, lifecycle or specialization-graph validity.
scope.no_inference: No hierarchy expansion, graph path inference, chain reconstruction, guessed group-member predicates or instance containment validation.
scope.composite_boundary: All 42 current element endpoint types are represented by exact B.5 cells. B.4 restricts derivation and does not blanket-filter direct metamodel permissions; B.6 element-to-element additions are already included in B.5. Group contents, instance containment, lifecycle, cycles and whole-model conformance remain unassessed. Eight Product/Plateau aggregation/composition triples retain explicit UNKNOWN scope qualifications.

trust_boundary.activation: Original code-owned CURRENT_PROFILE object supplied to createRegistry, checked by object identity.
not_authority: A serialized profile claiming the same evidence
trust_boundary.qualification: The identity gate activates this verified matrix only. Model references and metadata do not authenticate it.
trust_boundary.result_evidence: Verified result provenance requires the internal identity brand of a result returned by the genuine evaluator. Copied or forged result fields and source metadata do not acquire that brand.

implementation_boundary: Assessment results are advisory and computed separately from storage validation; creation and saving remain available. This bounded rule set is not a whole-model conformance certificate and does not validate multiplicity or graph cardinality.

qualification.issue: B.5 omits G/g for this exact pair. Generic composite wording in section 12.4 and the specific Product/Plateau qualification in B.4 leave the applicable scope unresolved. This is an interpretation ambiguity, not a claim that the standard contradicts itself.
qualification.resolution: Remove a qualified UNKNOWN only after authoritative source evidence (an official clarification, applicable erratum, or verified updated specification) explicitly settles Product/Plateau aggregation eligibility for that target. Independently review and record exact publication/hash/locators, preserve raw facts, update the per-triple disposition and regression tests. Do not infer resolution from another tool, a generic sentence, or a guessed precedence rule.

source_ambiguities.raw_table_policy: Retain the original absent G/g, matchedLetter null and not-listed classification. Do not insert a letter or claim a standard contradiction. Only these eight decisions remain UNKNOWN.
